correspondences.notes: Magnitude and phase are told apart by tags; BIDS uses the part-mag/part-phase entity.

brainlife.desc: T2*-weighted gradient-echo MRI (NIfTI), magnitude or phase (tags part-mag, part-phase), possibly multi-echo; input to QSM.
brainlife.name: neuro/anat/t2starw
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Phase unwrapping and B0/T2* mapping (ROMEO) towards QSM. Atlas-based segmentation of T2*-weighted magnitude images.

**Not for:** Apps expecting magnitude when the object is phase; check the part-mag or part-phase tag. Multi-echo processing when echo times are missing from metadata.

**BIDS:** anat/T2starw (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 2 Apps, output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.anat.t2starw.json
